profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Java Engineer | Spring Boot · Microservices · Kubernetes · Angular | AI Engineer (Anthropic) | RugsUSA · Cummins | Open to NJ/NYC Roles
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack Java engineer with over ten years of experience specializing in complex system integration and backend reliability. Much of my career has centered on a single challenge: making enterprise systems communicate cleanly and dependably — across ERPs, e-commerce platforms, and the services that connect them.
 
For the past several years, I've led backend and integration work on the platform behind RugsUSA.com. I own the Java and OFBiz ERP services, the Boomi integrations that synchronize orders, customers, and invoices across Shopify, OFBiz, and NetSuite, and much of the infrastructure that keeps these systems running in production. Recent projects include building an estimated-delivery-date feature that identifies a customer's nearest in-stock warehouse and returns a live FedEx estimate at checkout, hardening the NetSuite–OFBiz synchronization against timeout and authentication failures, and extending the OFBiz service engine to support evolving business requirements.
 
I also take ownership of the operational side of engineering — system configuration, production incident response, and the monitoring that surfaces issues early. I mentor new backend engineers through the OFBiz codebase and have trained an overseas team on our daily DevOps practices, establishing the standard operating procedures they use to triage issues, perform root-cause analysis, and escalate appropriately.
 
More recently, I've begun integrating AI into our engineering workflow — developing LLM-based agents that assist with documentation, testing, and support — and I'm pursuing an AI Engineering certification from Anthropic. I've found that a strong integration background translates directly to connecting AI systems with real-world enterprise data and tools.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Engineering lead for the Java-based ERP and e-commerce platform powering RugsUSA.com — one of the largest online rug retailers in the US — integrated with Shopify for inventory, orders, vendor management, payments, and real-time reporting.

• Architected Boomi integrations bridging Shopify and the Java ERP system via RESTful APIs and GraphQL, enabling seamless bi-directional data flow and eliminating manual reconciliation.
• Engineered end-to-end order lifecycle — Shopify intake → Java ERP processing → warehouse fulfillment → status sync — ensuring data consistency across all systems.
• Built and managed a Vendor Portal using Java, Spring Boot, Groovy, and MySQL, streamlining procurement between buyers and 50+ suppliers.
• Developed multi-gateway payment integrations (Bolt, Braintree, Google Pay) via React and Java, delivering seamless B2B and B2C checkout experiences.
• Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate build, test, and deployment workflows — reducing release cycle time and manual errors.
• Configured production infrastructure (NGINX, Cloudflare, deployment pipelines) and created AWS QuickSight dashboards for real-time WMS/ERP KPI monitoring.
• Drove delivery time optimization by engineering a location-aware shipping algorithm, identifying cost-effective routing for B2B and C2C customers.
• Automated system sync and deployments via Python scripts and cron jobs; integrated MongoDB as a high-volume logging layer to reduce MySQL load.
positions.insights: Skills: NetSuite · GraphQL · Shopify · Java · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · MySQL · Cloudflare · MongoDB · Nginx · Spring Boot · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · JavaScript Libraries · REST APIs · Dell Boomi

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained WWSPS — a global distributor management system used by 100+ service providers across multiple regions worldwide — using Java, Spring Boot microservices, and Oracle DB.
• Designed and built Spring Boot microservices for the WWSPS platform using Java 1.8, Spring MVC, JPA, Swagger, and Oracle DB, supporting 100+ global distributors.
• Containerized and deployed microservices using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, improving deployment reliability and enabling zero-downtime rolling updates.
• Developed data reporting modules delivering product, location, and regional analytics; built Angular + Bootstrap UIs with full REST/Swagger API integration.
• Improved application performance by analyzing customer feedback and system issues, translating findings into targeted technical solutions.
• Ensured code quality through JUnit unit tests and Postman integration tests; collaborated in bi-weekly Agile sprints with cross-functional teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Angular · Docker · Microservices · Spring Boot · Kubernetes · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · JavaScript Libraries · Oracle Database · REST APIs · Agile Methodologies

projects.title: AI Customer Support Chatbot
projects.description:
Designed, built, and deployed a conversational AI assistant for customer queries, product FAQs, and order lookups using the Anthropic Claude API and a Java Spring Boot backend on AWS.
• Developed context-aware multi-turn conversations with dynamic prompt engineering to control tone, scope, and response format.
• Deployed end-to-end on AWS — backend API, MongoDB conversation store, Angular frontend — validated across 50+ real customer query scenarios.
• Designed a modular prompt template architecture enabling rapid adaptation across product categories.

projects.description:
Researched about RFID, NFC technology for password authentication using ibeacon and publish research paper.
